whoIsItQuestions.text: Who in this room will still be single in five years?
Who forgets their own birthday, but remembers everybody else's?
Who eats the last piece of something and pretends it was not there?
Who has the worst handwriting in this room but still writes notes to themselves?
Who cries at a commercial but claims they do not cry?
Who has more unfinished projects on their phone than apps?
Who says "I will do it later" and actually means "never"?
Who apologises for things that were not their fault?
Who is the last person to reply in the family group chat?
Who turns every small decision into a committee meeting?
Who has a phone full of photos of food they never ate?
Who talks to themselves when they are alone?
Who cannot walk past a street dog without feeding it?
Who has strong opinions about rice and dal and will argue about it?
Who forgets to drink water until they get a headache?
Who is the family member who knows every single family secret?
Who would survive a zombie apocalypse, and who would feed the zombie?
Who replies "hmm" to everything and somehow always has a point?
Who has a chair at home that only they sit on?
Who is the first to be bored and the last to admit it?
Who hides snacks in a place they will forget?
Who talks with their hands and knocks something over every time?
Who can find a single needle in a haystack, but cannot find their keys?
Who sends a message and then checks whether it was delivered, five times?
Who has ever blamed the dog for something they did?
Who argues with the television when the football is on?
Who is the one who knows which drawer the scissors are in?
Who always takes the last slice and says they will pay next time?
Who has a plan for everything except their own life?
Who says "basement" and means the storage room in the kitchen?
Who would rather be late than admit they were wrong?
Who sings in the shower and thinks nobody can hear?
Who has a favourite chair in the whole house and defends it?
Who is the reason the family group chat has a hundred unread messages?
Who buys a new phone and keeps the old one in a drawer for two years?
Who eats the crispy bit of the samosa and leaves the soft one for somebody else?
Who is the family member who says "I told you so" the most?
Who has lost the same set of keys three times?
Who finishes other people's sentences and gets it wrong?
Who cannot be trusted with the last slice of cake, and knows it?
Who is the one who always offers food and never accepts it?
Who has a phone case older than the phone itself?
Who becomes a completely different person after the second half of a film?
Who is the one who replies to every message with "ok" or "hmm"?
Who keeps every gift wrapper in a drawer, just in case?
Who has strong feelings about who sits where at the dinner table?
Who is the one who can fix anything with a piece of tape?
Who checks the oven four times while waiting for something to bake?
Who has a story about a time they met a celebrity and it is not true?
Who turns every small talk into a deep conversation?
Who is the one who knows the price of everything in the shop?
Who has a favourite pen and will not use any other?
Who cannot walk through a room without rearranging something?
Who is the one who remembers what everybody said three years ago?
Who has ever won an argument by simply giving up and walking out?
Who is the family member who turns a two-minute job into a two-hour project?
Who always says "I am just looking" and comes back with six things?
Who has the most screenshots of other people's messages?
Who is the one who can be trusted to water the plants, but only once?
Who laughs at their own joke before they finish telling it?
Who has the most photos of food they never ate?
Who says "I will do it later" and means never?
Who forgets their own birthday but remembers everybody else's?
Who has a phone full of screenshots and no photos?
Who finds a needle in a haystack but cannot find their keys?
Who replies "hmm" to everything and always has a point?
Who takes the last slice and promises to pay next time?
Who says "basement" and means the cupboard under the stairs?
Who can fix anything with a piece of tape?
Who eats the crispy bit of the samosa and leaves the soft one?
Who says "I told you so" the most?
Who is the one who checks the oven four times while waiting?
Who always offers food and never accepts it?
Who remembers what everybody said three years ago?
Who would feed a street dog before eating their own food?
Who is the family member who gives the best advice and takes the least?
Who has ever replied "hmm" and then apologised an hour later?
Who is the one who is always slightly too early and slightly too late?
